paper_title: Matrix Multiplication Verification Using Coding Theory
classifications: Theory of computation → Design and analysis of algorithms
Theory of computation → Pseudorandomness and derandomization
statement: Of course, the main question that we leave open is whether Freivalds’s algorithm can be fully derandomized, i.e., whether there is a deterministic O(ne 2 )-time algorithm for MMV on n × n matrices over finite fields Fq with q ≤ poly(n) and integer matrices with entries [−nc , nc ] for constant c > 0. Additionally, it would be interesting to extend our results for MMV in the sparse regime to Output Sensitive Matrix Multiplication. The coding-theoretic techniques that we use seem amenable to this.
